name: Barnaby
description: A five-year-old fox with big questions, a warm yellow sweater and a habit of choosing the most interesting path.
alt: Barnaby, a young red fox in a yellow knitted sweater

name: Mum
description: Kind, patient and always ready with a calm answer, a warm hug or a clever woodland idea.
alt: Barnaby's mother, an adult red fox in a cream cardigan and green skirt

name: Pip
description: A small, big-eared companion who notices details that everyone else misses.
alt: Pip, a small golden-brown mouse with large ears and green eyes

name: The Little Guardian
description: A magical leaf-covered guardian who watches over the deeper secrets of the Whispering Woods.
alt: The Little Guardian, a golden woodland creature covered in leaves and quills

name: The Tiny Green Frog
description: A cheerful little adventurer who often rides in Barnaby's bicycle basket and says plenty without words.
alt: A friendly tiny green frog with big golden eyes

name: Willow
description: A gentle young fox who brings patience, imagination and a teal scarf to every woodland problem.
alt: Willow, a young red fox wearing a teal scarf

name: Twinkle
description: A tiny golden Glowkin whose light makes dark paths feel a little less mysterious.
alt: Twinkle, a tiny glowing golden woodland creature

name: The Human Girl
role: A visitor from beyond the woods
description: A curious child who reminds Barnaby that wonder can connect very different worlds.
alt: A young human girl wearing a flower-patterned blue jacket and pink boots

name: Mr Alder
description: A friendly badger who makes warm lights for the village and knows when a path needs guiding.
alt: Mr Alder, a friendly badger holding a glowing lantern

name: Mr Bramble
description: A wise hedgehog with a love of maps, handmade toys and unfinished routes worth following.
alt: Mr Bramble, a friendly hedgehog wearing spectacles and a rust-coloured scarf
